title: Creative testing
content:
# Creative testing

Test Meta creative variations by creating N ads inside one ad set with the creatives[] shape on POST /v1/ads/create.

import { Tab, Tabs } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/tabs';

Test creative variations by passing `creatives[]` on `POST /v1/ads/create`. You get one ad set and N ads that share a budget, targeting and schedule, under a new campaign or one you already have.

## Before you start

You need the same `accountId` and `adAccountId` as any other [create](/platforms/meta-ads/create-ads#create-a-campaign).

## Create N ads in one ad set

The budget stays pooled instead of splitting across parallel ad sets and their [learning phases](/platforms/meta-ads/ad-sets#learning-phase). Meta's delivery algorithm allocates it across the ads inside the single ad set.

`creatives[]` replaces the top-level `headline`, `body`, `imageUrl`, `linkUrl` and `callToAction`. Everything else stays where it was.

<Tabs items={['Node.js', 'Python', 'curl']}>
<Tab value="Node.js">
```typescript
import Zernio from '@zernio/node';

const zernio = new Zernio();

const { data: test } = await zernio.adcampaigns.createStandaloneAd({
  body: {
    accountId: '66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d',
    adAccountId: 'act_1234567890',
    name: 'Spring launch',
    goal: 'traffic',
    budgetAmount: 100,
    budgetType: 'daily',
    countries: ['US'],
    ageMin: 25,
    ageMax: 45,
    creatives: [
      { headline: 'Spring, 30% off', body: 'Limited time.', imageUrl: 'https://cdn.example.com/a.jpg', linkUrl: 'https://example.com/a', callToAction: 'SHOP_NOW' },
      { headline: 'Curated for you', body: 'Our picks.', imageUrl: 'https://cdn.example.com/b.jpg', linkUrl: 'https://example.com/b', callToAction: 'SHOP_NOW' },
      { headline: 'Free shipping', body: 'This week only.', imageUrl: 'https://cdn.example.com/c.jpg', linkUrl: 'https://example.com/c', callToAction: 'SHOP_NOW' }
    ]
  }
});

const adSetId = test.platformAdSetId;
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Python">
```python
from zernio import Zernio

client = Zernio()

test = client.ad_campaigns.create_standalone_ad(
    account_id="66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d",
    ad_account_id="act_1234567890",
    name="Spring launch",
    goal="traffic",
    budget_amount=100,
    budget_type="daily",
    countries=["US"],
    age_min=25,
    age_max=45,
    creatives=[
        {"headline": "Spring, 30% off", "body": "Limited time.", "imageUrl": "https://cdn.example.com/a.jpg", "linkUrl": "https://example.com/a", "callToAction": "SHOP_NOW"},
        {"headline": "Curated for you", "body": "Our picks.", "imageUrl": "https://cdn.example.com/b.jpg", "linkUrl": "https://example.com/b", "callToAction": "SHOP_NOW"},
        {"headline": "Free shipping", "body": "This week only.", "imageUrl": "https://cdn.example.com/c.jpg", "linkUrl": "https://example.com/c", "callToAction": "SHOP_NOW"},
    ],
)

ad_set_id = test["platformAdSetId"]
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl -X POST "https://zernio.com/api/v1/ads/create" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "accountId": "66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d",
    "adAccountId": "act_1234567890",
    "name": "Spring launch",
    "goal": "traffic",
    "budgetAmount": 100,
    "budgetType": "daily",
    "countries": ["US"],
    "ageMin": 25,
    "ageMax": 45,
    "creatives": [
      { "headline": "Spring, 30% off", "body": "Limited time.", "imageUrl": "https://cdn.example.com/a.jpg", "linkUrl": "https://example.com/a", "callToAction": "SHOP_NOW" },
      { "headline": "Curated for you", "body": "Our picks.", "imageUrl": "https://cdn.example.com/b.jpg", "linkUrl": "https://example.com/b", "callToAction": "SHOP_NOW" },
      { "headline": "Free shipping", "body": "This week only.", "imageUrl": "https://cdn.example.com/c.jpg", "linkUrl": "https://example.com/c", "callToAction": "SHOP_NOW" }
    ]
  }'
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

Response (`201`), trimmed to the first ad:

```json
{
  "platformCampaignId": "120250000000000004",
  "platformAdSetId": "120250000000000005",
  "ads": [
    {
      "_id": "66d4a1b2c3e4f5a6b7c8d9e4",
      "name": "Spring launch #1",
      "status": "pending_review",
      "reviewStatus": "in_review",
      "platformAdSetId": "120250000000000005"
    }
  ]
}
```

The multi-creative response carries `ads[]` instead of the single shape's `ad`. Every entry shares `platformCampaignId` and `platformAdSetId`.

Each ad is named `"<name> #N"`, so the request above produces "Spring launch #1" through "Spring launch #3". Set `name` on an entry to choose that ad's exact name instead.

Each entry takes `video: { url, thumbnailUrl }` in place of `imageUrl` for a video variation ([creatives](/platforms/meta-ads/creatives#video-creatives)).

A call takes up to 50 entries.

## Launch a creative matrix

To launch every creative and text against several audiences, send one call per audience.

The first call creates the campaign. Each later call passes its id as `existingCampaignId`, and adds one ad set with its own targeting and all its ads.

Entries that repeat an `imageUrl` or `video.url` share one upload, so repeating an asset across texts costs nothing extra.

Send `status: "PAUSED"` to review the matrix before it spends.

<Tabs items={['Node.js', 'Python', 'curl']}>
<Tab value="Node.js">
```typescript
import Zernio from '@zernio/node';

const zernio = new Zernio();

const assets = [
  { key: 'hook-1', imageUrl: 'https://cdn.example.com/hook-1.jpg' },
  { key: 'hook-2', imageUrl: 'https://cdn.example.com/hook-2.jpg' },
];
const texts = [
  { key: 'body-1', headline: 'Spring, 30% off', body: 'Limited time.' },
  { key: 'body-2', headline: 'New season, new deals', body: 'Shop the range.' },
];
const creatives = assets.flatMap((asset) => texts.map((text) => ({
  name: `Spring - ${asset.key}_${text.key}`,
  headline: text.headline,
  body: text.body,
  imageUrl: asset.imageUrl,
  linkUrl: 'https://example.com/spring',
  callToAction: 'SHOP_NOW',
})));

const shared = {
  accountId: '66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d',
  adAccountId: 'act_1234567890',
  name: 'Spring',
  goal: 'traffic',
  budgetAmount: 50,
  budgetType: 'daily',
  status: 'PAUSED',
  creatives,
};

const { data: first } = await zernio.adcampaigns.createStandaloneAd({
  body: { ...shared, campaignName: 'Spring', adSetName: 'US', countries: ['US'] },
});

await zernio.adcampaigns.createStandaloneAd({
  body: { ...shared, existingCampaignId: first.platformCampaignId, adSetName: 'UK', countries: ['GB'] },
});
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Python">
```python
from zernio import Zernio

client = Zernio()

assets = [
    {"key": "hook-1", "image_url": "https://cdn.example.com/hook-1.jpg"},
    {"key": "hook-2", "image_url": "https://cdn.example.com/hook-2.jpg"},
]
texts = [
    {"key": "body-1", "headline": "Spring, 30% off", "body": "Limited time."},
    {"key": "body-2", "headline": "New season, new deals", "body": "Shop the range."},
]
creatives = [
    {
        "name": f"Spring - {asset['key']}_{text['key']}",
        "headline": text["headline"],
        "body": text["body"],
        "imageUrl": asset["image_url"],
        "linkUrl": "https://example.com/spring",
        "callToAction": "SHOP_NOW",
    }
    for asset in assets
    for text in texts
]

shared = dict(
    account_id="66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d",
    ad_account_id="act_1234567890",
    name="Spring",
    goal="traffic",
    budget_amount=50,
    budget_type="daily",
    status="PAUSED",
    creatives=creatives,
)

first = client.ad_campaigns.create_standalone_ad(**shared, campaign_name="Spring", ad_set_name="US", countries=["US"])

client.ad_campaigns.create_standalone_ad(
    **shared, existing_campaign_id=first.platform_campaign_id, ad_set_name="UK", countries=["GB"],
)
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl -X POST https://zernio.com/api/v1/ads/create \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "accountId": "66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d",
    "adAccountId": "act_1234567890",
    "name": "Spring",
    "goal": "traffic",
    "budgetAmount": 50,
    "budgetType": "daily",
    "status": "PAUSED",
    "existingCampaignId": "23508518100",
    "adSetName": "UK",
    "countries": ["GB"],
    "creatives": [
      { "name": "Spring - hook-1_body-1", "headline": "Spring, 30% off", "body": "Limited time.", "imageUrl": "https://cdn.example.com/hook-1.jpg", "linkUrl": "https://example.com/spring", "callToAction": "SHOP_NOW" },
      { "name": "Spring - hook-1_body-2", "headline": "New season, new deals", "body": "Shop the range.", "imageUrl": "https://cdn.example.com/hook-1.jpg", "linkUrl": "https://example.com/spring", "callToAction": "SHOP_NOW" }
    ]
  }'
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

If the campaign holds the budget (CBO), omit `budgetAmount` and `budgetType` on the calls that join it. If its ad sets hold the budget (ABO), send them on every call.

The joined campaign's status never changes.

## Add a variation later

To test a fourth creative without starting a new campaign, pass the ad set's id as `adSetId` on a fresh `POST /v1/ads/create` with a single creative.

The new ad joins the ad set and inherits its budget, targeting and schedule. It keeps the learning Meta has already done.

See [attach a creative to an existing ad set](/platforms/meta-ads/creatives#attach-a-creative-to-an-existing-ad-set).

## Read the results per creative

Rolled-up metrics land on each ad node of [`GET /v1/ads/tree`](/platforms/meta-ads/create-ads#reading-the-campaign-tree), which is enough to rank the variations.

To split a single ad's results by the asset Meta served, use the creative-asset [breakdowns](/platforms/meta-ads/analytics#demographic-and-placement-breakdowns): `image_asset`, `video_asset`, `body_asset`, `title_asset`.

`creatives[]` is not the same as `dynamicCreative`. That hands Meta a pool of headlines, bodies and images to recombine inside one ad.

Use `creatives[]` when you want N distinct ads you can read separately.

## If it fails

A `400` means `creatives[]` was combined with a shape that owns the creative:

```json
{
  "error": "\"creatives\" and \"adSetId\" are mutually exclusive. Use `creatives[]` to create a new ad set with multiple creatives, or `adSetId` to attach a single new creative to an existing ad set.",
  "type": "invalid_request_error",
  "code": "mutually_exclusive_fields",
  "param": "creatives"
}
```

The same `400` covers `placementAssets`, `carouselCards`, `existingCreativeId`, `translations` and `buyingType: "RESERVED"`, and more than 50 entries.

The top-level `headline`, `body`, `imageUrl`, `linkUrl` and `callToAction` are not in that set. This mode ignores them rather than rejecting them, so there is nothing to remove from the request.

Non-Meta platforms return a `400` as well: this shape is Meta only.
